game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens, the chapel gardens: the herald must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the castle gate.
theme: The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens: the chapel gardens
core_gameplay_loop: In Chapel Gardens, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the castle gate. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the castle gate using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The castle gate reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the castle gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Chapel Gardens'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Chapel Gardens.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The castle gate reached with actions_used <= 12.
